_note: Active set is restricted to three open-weight J-Lens models. Behavioral sweeps run through OpenRouter; the same checkpoints load from HF with their lenses for mechanistic follow-up. `excluded` records what was dropped and why.

jlens._note: ACTIVE SET for all new experiments: three open-weight models with published J-Lens weights, spanning dense vs MoE at matched scale and two independent training lineages. The `lens` field is the folder in camilablank/workspace-lenses.

qwen/qwen3.6-27b.why: richest tooling of any J-Lens model: single-token lens, multi-token template lens, and a natural-language autoencoder. Primary subject.

qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b.why: MoE counterpart to qwen3.6-27b at matched scale and generation, both lensed. Enables a behavioral test of the prediction that MoE has lower opaque serial depth than dense.

lenses.r-lens: r-lens/lens.pt (swept-winner MoE config: LRP rules on all routed experts, frozen routing)
lenses.note: the R-lens writeup reports no R-lens advantage on its two smallest dense and MoE models; this model may be one of them, so its early-layer reads may be no better than J-lens quality. Not a blocker, but do not treat an early-layer null here as strong evidence of absence.

google/gemma-3-27b-it.why: only non-Qwen lensed model. Required to show results are not a Qwen-family artifact. Well supported in TransformerLens and nnsight.

jlens._lens_policy: R-lens only (LRP-modified backward graph, RelP arXiv:2508.21258): cleaner and earlier reads on the first half of layers, which is where our layers-per-hop measurement lives. J-lens is not used. Because we give up the matched-pair agreement check, lens readouts are treated as HYPOTHESES ONLY until confirmed by (a) cross-example residualization, (b) a null control scoring a code from a different random mapping, and (c) a KV-cache transplant at the positions the lens implicates. The transplant is lens-independent and is the load-bearing validation.

excluded._note: Dropped by the open-weights + J-Lens requirement. Kept for provenance: pilot results on these are in the repo but cannot be followed up mechanistically.
excluded.openai/gpt-5.1: closed weights; also had CoT instruction-compliance failures
excluded.deepseek/deepseek-chat: open weights but no J-Lens published
excluded.moonshotai/kimi-k2-0905: open weights but no J-Lens published
excluded.qwen/qwen3-max: no J-Lens; also unstable under concurrency in the pilot
excluded.qwen/qwen3.5-9b: has a J-Lens but outside the active three-model set: smallest lensed model that is also on OpenRouter
excluded.qwen/qwen3.5-27b: has a J-Lens but outside the active three-model set: same size and family as qwen3
excluded.qwen/qwen3.5-122b-a10b: has a J-Lens but outside the active three-model set: upper-mid scale point within the Qwen family for a scale sweep
excluded.qwen/qwen3.5-4b: has a J-Lens but outside the active three-model set: lensed and tiny, but NOT served on OpenRouter
excluded.deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash: has a J-Lens but outside the active three-model set: frontier-scale anchor, lensed, and the model named in the filler-token literature as benefiting from filler
